title: Served record
description: A harness plugin's binding of a thread to the harness's own thread ID, two per received prompt; on TRACE.{account}.edges, signed. Written by the plugins of the harnesses that cannot put the SDK's headers on their own model calls, OpenClaw and Claude Code; PI stamps the SDK's headers on its own calls and writes none.

version.description: schema version of this record kind; additive changes bump it, breaking changes are a new subject

record_id.description: the Agent-Sender nonce for this signed record; also the Nats-Msg-Id

agent.description: the plugin's own AgentId — the executing agent

thread_id.description: from the envelope, or minted by the plugin when the envelope carried none

root_id.description: 128-bit random, lower-case hex, minted by the caller at prompt()

harness_thread_id.description: the harness's own thread ID, bare, the same string the proxy writes as harness_thread_id on the calls it files under it: claude — {session}; openclaw — the 32-hex trace ID; no prefix

$comment: harness is claude or openclaw, the harnesses whose plugins write this record. harness_thread_id is bare, and the thread record carries the same pair, so a reader joins the two by equality.
